About.title: About Giovani
About.bio1: Giovani is a seasoned speaker and executive coach with over 20 years of experience working with leading companies across Latin America.
About.bio2: His work combines strategic leadership frameworks with practical behavioral tools, helping professionals at every level achieve lasting transformation.
About.bio3: Certified in NLP and Situational Leadership, Giovani brings a unique blend of technical expertise and human connection to every engagement.

Services.title: Services
Services.card1_desc: High-impact keynotes and lectures designed to inspire behavioral change and motivate teams toward new habits and peak performance.
Services.card2_desc: Customized 6–9 month programs combining feedback, group training, and individual monitoring to develop leaders at every level.
Services.card3_desc: One-on-one coaching structured around three pillars: goal clarification, strategic action planning, and sustained motivation.
Services.card4_desc: Intensive training programs for professionals who want to develop their public speaking and facilitation skills.
